name: Park Hill Plaza
summary: Park Hill Plaza is a clean, well-maintained neighborhood shopping center in Yucca Valley anchored by Vons supermarket, US Bank, and Angle View. The plaza serves as a convenient one-stop destination for essential shopping and banking services for local residents and Joshua Tree area visitors.
demographics: Park Hill Plaza serves the Yucca Valley community and surrounding High Desert region, attracting a diverse mix of local residents and tourists visiting Joshua Tree National Park. The primary trade area consists of middle-income families, retirees, and outdoor enthusiasts, with household incomes ranging from moderate to middle class. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to everyday necessities and banking services, with a preference for value-oriented retailers and essential services that cater to both permanent residents and the area's growing visitor population.
description: Park Hill Plaza is a convenient neighborhood shopping center located at 57533 29 Palms Highway in Yucca Valley, California, serving as a vital retail hub for the High Desert community. This well-maintained plaza features a practical mix of essential services and retailers, anchored by Vons supermarket, which provides residents with comprehensive grocery shopping options. The center also houses Angle View and US Bank, offering important financial services to the local community. With a 4.3-star rating from 34 reviews, visitors consistently praise the plaza for its cleanliness and well-kept facilities, with one reviewer noting it as "very clean very nice place" and another highlighting the "fresh clean and tons of great deals." The convenient co-location of multiple essential services in one parking lot makes Park Hill Plaza a practical one-stop destination for Yucca Valley residents and visitors exploring the nearby Joshua Tree area.
